lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five to six vertical columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits, transitioning into a sparse grid of distributed spots toward the mid-posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot alignments, creating distinct anchor nodes across the central lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance contrast with highlights on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent concave indentation or notch is visible on the posterior margin of the pectoral fin. An irregular white depigmented patch or scar is located on the partially visible fin structure in the upper-left quadrant.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple commensal organisms (remoras) are visible attached to the ventral surface and swimming in the immediate proximity below the pectoral fin.
